question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"existence".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The word **"existence" **means the state of being alive or present.
 
• It is the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 4". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Skill,** refers to a particular ability or expertise.
 
• **End, **means the point in time when something finishes or ceases to exist.
 
• **Enhancement, **means the act of improving or adding value to something.
